items.headline: Lazare, veni foras: Reprogramming Dormant Neurons to Backdoor AI Agents
items.excerpt: Microsoft researchers have discovered “Lazarus,” a backdoor technique that can reprogram dormant neurons in an AI model, causing an otherwise normal AI agent to execute malicious commands when a hidden trigger appears.
